notes: Data cross-confirmed from two independent official Samsung documents: the Samsung US support/spec page (samsung.com/us/business/support/owners/product/qmr-series-digital-signage-qm43r/) and Samsung's official German technical datasheet PDF ("Technische Daten QM43R", Samsung Electronics GmbH, model LH43QMREPGCXEN, Mar 2021) — both agree on 2x HDMI IN + 1x HDMI OUT (all HDMI 2.0/HDCP2.2), DP 1.2 IN, DVI-D IN, 2x USB 2.0, RS232C IN/OUT via 3.5mm mini-jack, RJ45, and stereo mini-jack audio I/O. RJ45 speed (10/100 Mbps, i.e. eth-100m) confirmed via the Samsung/B&H-hosted user manual text. Built-in stereo speakers (10W+10W) are internal, not an external port. Note a later regional running-change SKU, QM43R-A (per its Distrelec/Swiss datasheet), simplifies connectivity — no DVI-D input and no HDMI loop-out are listed for that variant — so verify against the exact SKU/region before purchasing cables if targeting that revision. No rack-mount option; this is a wall/stand-mount flat panel (VESA 200x200mm), so rackUnits is omitted.

ports.name: HDMI OUT
ports.note: Loop-out for daisy-chaining multiple displays (HDCP2.2: up to 4 units, HDCP1.4: up to 7 units)

ports.name: AUDIO IN
ports.note: Stereo mini-jack; provides analog audio for the DVI-D input (DVI carries no embedded audio)

ports.name: RS232C IN
ports.note: Physically a 3.5mm stereo mini-jack carrying RS-232 serial control signal, not audio; needs a mini-jack-to-DE9 adapter cable to reach standard RS232 gear

ports.name: RS232C OUT
ports.note: 3.5mm mini-jack RS-232 loop-through for daisy-chaining MDC control to additional displays

ports.name: AC IN
ports.note: Internal power supply, 100-240V AC 50/60Hz; exact inlet shape (IEC C13/C14 vs captive cord) was not explicitly pictured in the spec sheets reviewed and is inferred from the QMR series norm (Samsung lists a detachable 'power cord' as an in-box accessory)
